affix.note: Prefix and suffix icons via inputs; arbitrary content via [solaris-form-prefix] / [solaris-form-suffix]. Interactive content uses the suffix-action slot with both [solaris-form-suffix] and [solaris-form-suffix-action].

ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

clearable.label: E-mail
clearable.note: With clearable, a clear button appears when the field has a value and emits cleared on click. It stays hidden while disabled, readonly, or loading.

email-field.description: Form Field preset for email input with email-specific defaults, validation, and domain filtering. Composes Form Field + Input.

examples.note: Basic email field with email keyboard, autocomplete, and validation on blur.

form.label: Required e-mail
form.note: Works with Reactive Forms through ControlValueAccessor. Pair with solarisEmailValidator for template-independent validation.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the email field component.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

radius.note: Radius follows the global scale: md maps to 4px, lg to 8px, and xl renders as a pill.

size-density.note: Size and density combine into a 3x3 matrix: the inner Form Field owns the outer height while the preset keeps font and padding in sync.

states.note: Disabled and readonly are real, not visual-only. Loading renders a spinner overlay in the suffix slot without shifting the layout.

email-field.title: Email Field

validation.note: Domain allow and block lists with optional lowercase normalization on blur. Validation runs after blur, never while focused.
